name: live-trans
description: Real-time desktop translator for system audio, powered by Gemini 3.5 Live Translate
author: minhnhat165

scripts.build:win-helper: cmake -S native/win-audio-capture -B native/win-audio-capture/build -A x64 && cmake --build native/win-audio-capture/build --config Release
scripts.dist:win: bun run build:win-helper && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win
scripts.pack:win: bun run build:win-helper && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win dir
